title: Training Notes on the Annual Review of the Property Charge Advance Repayment At-Risk Extension
content:
**Rule.** A Property Charge Advance Repayment At-Risk Extension is reviewed every 12 months from the date the agreement was signed, once per review year. It is renewed only when the youngest borrower still occupies the home and the documented critical circumstance continues; otherwise the review outcome is not renewed and the record is referred. The At-Risk Extension carries the product's at-risk installment amount monthly, and the borrower must keep paying new charges, as the product's current-charges term provides.

## Questions and answers

**From what date are reviews counted?**
From the date every borrower signed the At-Risk Extension agreement; a review falls every 12 months after it.

**How many reviews may one review year have?**
One. A review year already reviewed for the extension is not reviewed again; whether it is on record is read from the extension's records before the review is recorded.

**When is the extension renewed?**
Only when both conditions hold at the review: the youngest borrower still occupies the home, and the documented critical circumstance continues.

**What if either condition fails?**
The review outcome is not renewed, and the record is referred.

**What does the borrower pay monthly during the extension?**
The at-risk installment amount set for the At-Risk Extension. Separately, the borrower must keep paying new property charges.

## Review outcomes

| Youngest borrower still occupies the home | Documented critical circumstance continues | Review outcome |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Renewed |
| Yes | No | Not renewed; the record is referred |
| No | Yes | Not renewed; the record is referred |
| No | No | Not renewed; the record is referred |

### Hypothetical review calendar

An At-Risk Extension signed on 9 September of a hypothetical year is reviewed on 9 September of the following year for that review year, and every 12 months thereafter. The date is illustrative only.
